gaps.explanation: The only business-type fund in the financial statements is the Utilities Fund (p7, printed p11): Total Operating Revenues 510,270 + Interest Income 1,090 = 511,360 = statement_total; detail[] has those same three lines (500,270 + 10,000 + 1,090). The rest of schedule_total 8,164,179 is detail index 47, 'Nursing Home Charges' 7,652,819 (fund Nursing Home), from the unaudited Budgetary Comparison Schedule - All Funds (p9, printed p26), which also covers the Nursing Home. The Nursing Home is not in any of the city's fund statements, so the statement has no Nursing Home revenue. 8,164,179 - 7,652,819 = 511,360. The schedule covers more than the statement does. This is a real difference in scope, not an extraction error, so no lines are added or removed (the line is already marked outside_statement).

Utilities Fund Total Operating Expenses 451,893 (p7, printed p11) = statement_total; detail[] has the 11 printed expense rows (203,722 + 36,312 + 16,336 + 33,058 + 26,604 + 1,350 + 35,151 + 14,446 + 82,701 + 1,213 + 1,000 = 451,893). The remainder of schedule_total 7,149,402 is detail index 48, 'Nursing Home' 6,697,509, from the unaudited Budgetary Comparison Schedule - All Funds (p9, printed p26, Charges to Appropriations). That fund is not in the audited statements. 7,149,402 - 6,697,509 = 451,893. The schedule covers more than the statement does, so no lines are added or removed.
